audience: email marketers who send newsletters and run automations with NewsMAN

useCases.title: Compare newsletter results
useCases.text: The AI lists the newsletters of a list and shows sends, views, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces and the most clicked links of each.

useCases.title: Track list growth
useCases.text: The AI counts the active subscribers of each list and shows daily totals, unsubscribes, spam reports and hard bounces for up to 90 days.

useCases.title: Look up a subscriber
useCases.text: The AI finds a subscriber by email, shows status, properties and segments, and the last 100 actions such as opens, clicks and bounces.

useCases.title: Subscribe and tag a person who gave consent
useCases.text: The AI subscribes the email address of a person who gave consent to a list, with name and properties, and adds tags. The subscriber is active at once.

useCases.title: Handle an unsubscribe request
useCases.text: The AI checks the subscriber's status on a list and unsubscribes the address, so it no longer receives campaigns from that list.

useCases.title: Check automation performance
useCases.text: The AI lists the automation workflows of a list and shows their daily sends, opens, clicks, purchases and unsubscribes.
